Scanned from a copy in the Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The positive sciences of the ancient Hindus · Seal, Brajendranath, Sir, 1864-1938 · 1915, 318 scanned pages. Published 1915; Brajendranath Seal died 1938; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
